final_boundary: READY_TO_SHIP. Audio Manager Pro passed 62/62 automated tests plus PackRat PI/key/profile/native/Elgato/package/art gates on the validated candidate, and the product owner accepted the completed physical Windows/Stream Deck workflow: profile capture/save/apply, output/input switching, bundled profile layout, PI persistence/width safety, simplified key faces, and final mic wording. VoiceMeeter routing remains an explicitly documented Windows-endpoint mute boundary, not a release blocker.

automated_release_evidence.note: The remaining PI design-audit warnings on this run were legacy action icon-folder naming warnings, not runtime or visual-release blockers.
